# Baalvion Insiders

> A free, public directory of investment firms and the companies raising capital from them,
> compiled entirely from primary public records. Every figure traces to a filing you can open.

## What is here

- 28,367 investment firms (venture capital and private equity), from SEC Form D filings
- 114,889 companies that have raised capital, from SEC Form D and national company registers
- 268,981 distinct named executives, directors and promoters, linked across both sides
- 77 countries, 8,460 cities

Counted 2026-09-08 from the live database. Form D coverage runs 2018q3–2026q2 (32 quarters).
Firm count is lower than the raw filer count because one firm raises many fund vehicles and they
are merged into a single record; people are counted as distinct names, not filing appearances.

## Sources and their limits

- **SEC Form D** (US, public domain): the notice a private fund or company files when raising
  under Regulation D. Carries the filer's own business address and telephone. Does NOT carry
  email, website, sector thesis, stage preference or cheque size — those fields are left empty
  here rather than guessed.
- **Enhetsregisteret** (Norway) and **PRH/YTJ** (Finland): national company registers. Carry legal
  form, staff numbers, status and registration date. No funding data.

Figures are as filed and may be out of date. A filing means capital was raised, not that a firm is
currently investing. Roles are as filed; a director is not necessarily a founder.

## Key entry points

- https://www.marketunderworld.com/investors — investor directory
- https://www.marketunderworld.com/founders — companies and founders
- https://www.marketunderworld.com/directory — geographic index
- https://www.marketunderworld.com/people/{name-slug} — one person across every filing
- https://www.marketunderworld.com/sitemap.xml — sitemap index (13 sections)

## Citation

Cite the underlying filing where possible. Every profile links to its source document on SEC EDGAR
or the relevant national register.
